overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: one member attending a meeting left no quorum, so the meeting was not subject to the law. The AG declined to review the claim that a single member acted without authority.

allegations.summary: A single member of the three-member committee attended an unnoticed meeting of its Space Needs subcommittee with outside non-members, allegedly violating notice requirements.
allegations.key_passage: Where only one member of the Prudential Committee and Space Needs Committee attended the meeting at issue, there was no quorum of any public body present and the meeting was not subject to the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Allegation that directions were given and agreements made without authority, by one member acting alone.
allegations.key_passage: this allegation falls outside the scope of the Open Meeting Law and we decline to review it.
